points: Sisinnes the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, and his companions, following the commandments of king Darius, did very carefully oversee the holy works, assisting the ancients of the Jews and governors of the temple.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: The holy works prospered, when Aggeus and Zacharias the prophets prophesied; and they finished these things by the commandment of the Lord God of Israel.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: Thus was the holy house finished in the three and twentieth day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius king of the Persians.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: At the dedication of the temple of the Lord they offered an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and twelve goats for the sin of all Israel, according to the number of the chief of the tribes of Israel.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: The children of Israel that were of the captivity held the passover the fourteenth day of the first month, after the priests and the Levites were sanctified.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: They that were of the captivity did eat, even all they that had separated themselves from the abominations of the people of the land, and sought the Lord.

note.label: 1 Esdras 7: The House Finished and the Passover Kept

points: They kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before the Lord, for that he had turned the counsel of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of the Lord God of Israel.
